messages:
maria: Heads up — planning a CMK rotation for prod snapshot objects next Wed 02:00 UTC. Need to lock down RBAC changes for the backup-uploader service account and ensure the audit trail remains immutable. Any concerns?
kevin: Why rotate object encryption instead of just rotating the CMK alias?
samir: Some customers use tenant-scoped CMKs. Compliance requires objects to be re-encrypted to the tenant CMK ID, not just point an alias at a new key. We'll also move to ephemeral delegated grants for uploader/restore.
anna-sec: Ephemeral grants sound good. Important: re-encrypt flows often overwrite object metadata and can destroy original key/grant references. That would break forensic timelines. Do not lose original metadata.
maria: Proposed approach: do copy-to-new-object with new SSE-KMS key, preserve all metadata, and add a signed_original_metadata field that includes original kmsKeyId and grantId hash. Then mark original object as superseded rather than deleting immediately.
kevin: This doubles storage while rotation is in progress — ops needs to approve. How long do we keep both?
samir: Plan is 7 days retention for both copies, GC after canary restores succeed. For tenants with long-retention SLAs, offer an opt-out via escrow.
kevin: Grant-prune job runs hourly. If we create ephemeral grants and prune them too early, restores will fail. Need coordination.
anna-sec: Agreed. Options: extend grant TTL for rotation windows, or route restores through a dedicated long-restore grant service. Also emit audit events for grant creation including grant-id.
maria: POC copy command I'm testing:
```
aws s3 cp s3://snapshots/prod/snap-2026-03-20.db \
  s3://snapshots/prod/snap-2026-03-20.db.reenc \
  --metadata-directive REPLACE \
  --sse aws:kms \
  --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/NEW-CMK-UUID \
  --metadata signed_original_key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/OLD-CMK-UUID,signed_original_grant_id=GRNT-abc123
```
Note: copy to new object first, verify integrity and audit entries, then atomically swap pointer in our metadata service.
kevin: Add verification: validate signed_original_metadata signature and hash before accepting new object. Also emit a snapshot.reencrypt.completed audit event containing old_key_id and new_key_id.
encops-bot: Runbook draft: https://encops.internal/runbooks/cmk-rotation-snapshots (includes canary checklist). Canary scheduled Wed 01:30 UTC — full restore for 3 tenants.
samir: RBAC changes: backup-uploader SA will get kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt for NEW-CMK with a tag-based condition: only decrypt objects with tag reencrypt-in-progress=false to avoid reads during swap.
anna-sec: Ensure CloudTrail records still show original kmsKeyId for the copy operation. If CloudTrail logs only the new key, record original key in our app-level audit event so we keep the chain.
maria: I'll open PR to encops playbook: requirements = non-destructive re-encrypt (copy-to-new), signed_original_metadata, dual audit events (grant.create + snapshot.reencrypt.completed), GC window, and grant-ttl coordination. Also add a canary that intentionally prunes a grant to test failover path.
kevin: Ops — confirm capacity bump for the 24h rotation period. Expect ~1.5x storage peak.
encops-bot: Canary run scheduled Wed 01:30 UTC. Notifying oncall: @oncall-encops.
maria: Thanks all. I'll post PR link and tag @anna-sec for review when ready.
